## Overview

Under EP, route the AITER Triton W4A16 and W4A4 MoE over local experts only, as ROCm/ATOM does: the aiter top-k feeds `ep_sort_routing`. Follow-up to #59255.

## Claims

- DeepSeek-V4-Pro EP8: 1.1–2.6x output throughput vs #59255 (global routing). It now beats `triton_unfused` at every concurrency.
- gpt-oss-120b EP8: 1.1–2.0x, with no regression at conc 1.
- W4A4 EP fix: it already accepted EP but indexed local weights with global expert ids.

## Validation

gfx950:

| Model | Routing | tok/s | gsm8k |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4-Pro | this PR | 68 / 481 / 1402 / 2159 / 3322 | 0.935 |
| DeepSeek-V4-Pro | #59255 | 63 / 311 / 651 / 888 / 1275 | 0.930 |
| gpt-oss-120b | this PR | 286 / 1722 / 6138 / 11080 / 17622 | 0.905 |
| gpt-oss-120b | #59255 | 263 / 1384 / 3722 / 5784 / 8920 | 0.920 |

gfx942:

| Model | Routing | tok/s | gsm8k |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash | this PR | 96 / 592 / 1732 / 2584 / 3660 | 0.945 |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash | #59255 | 87 / 402 / 920 / 1335 / 1924 | 0.970 |
| gpt-oss-120b | this PR | 261 / 1280 / 3570 / 6531 / 9428 | 0.900 |
| gpt-oss-120b | #59255 | 243 / 883 / 2099 / 3127 / 4449 | 0.880 |

Note: W4A4 EP is partially tested on gfx1250, cc @jpvillam-amd

+def _dsv4_moe_config(monkeypatch, default_vllm_config, has_hash_routing, backend):
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.layer import FusedMoEFactory
+    from vllm.platforms import rocm
+
+    # Exercise both native MX and monolithic AITER selection on any ROCm device.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm, "on_gfx950", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm, "on_gfx1250", lambda: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_enabled", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "is_fused_moe_enabled", lambda: True)
+    default_vllm_config.kernel_config.moe_backend = "triton"
+    layer = FusedMoEFactory(
+        num_experts=8,
+        top_k=2,
+        hidden_size=256,

+        scoring_func="sqrtsoftplus",

+        prefix="hash_routing_selection",

+    return layer, replace(layer.routed_experts.moe_config, moe_backend=backend)

+@pytest.mark.skipif(not ROCM_AVAILABLE, reason="ROCm backend selection")

+)
+def test_hash_routing_backend_selection(
+    dist_init,
+    default_vllm_config,
+    monkeypatch,
+    has_hash_routing,
+    backend,
+    expected_experts,
+):
+    """Hash tables reach backend selection and hash-capable kernels."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import (
+        select_deepseek_v4_mxfp4_moe_backend,
+    )
+
+    layer, config = _dsv4_moe_config(
+        monkeypatch, default_vllm_config, has_hash_routing, backend
+    )
+    _, experts_cls = select_deepseek_v4_mxfp4_moe_backend(config)
+    assert experts_cls is not None
+    assert experts_cls.__name__ == expected_experts
+    # Monolithic kernels route internally, so they read the table from the layer.
+    assert (layer.routed_experts.hash_indices_table is not None) == has_hash_routing
+
+

+    gating_output: torch.Tensor,
+    topk: int,
+    renormalize: bool,

+            HIST_BLOCK_M=32,
+            score_mode=score_mode,
+            renorm=renormalize,
+            routed_scaling_factor=routed_scaling_factor,
+        )
+    elif score_mode is not None:
+        kwargs = dict(
+            apply_softmax=False,
+            score_mode=score_mode,
+            bias=bias.float() if bias is not None else None,
+            renorm=renormalize,
+            routed_scaling_factor=routed_scaling_factor,
+            HIST_BLOCK_M=32,
+        )
+        if num_expert_group is not None and num_expert_group > 1:

+                topk_group=topk_group,
+                **kwargs,
